units: B. Kam. 62ᵃ (defin.) חמסן … ג׳ לא יהיב וכ׳ ḥamsan (violent man) is one who (takes by force and) pays; gazlan—who takes without paying.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26b:17">Snh. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ דאורייתא</he> a robber in the strict (Biblical) sense; <he>ג׳ דרבנן</he> a robber in a wider (Rabbinical) sense, e.g. a gambler &c.; ib. 25ᵇ.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:3:4">Y. Snh. VIII, 26ᵇ</cite> he who takes an object in the presence of witnesses is called thief (<cite ref="C01080"><he>גַּנָּב</he></cite>), he who takes in the owner’s presence—<he>ג׳</he> a robber; v.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 2:1:10">Y. Kidd. II, 62ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כל המשנה וכ׳</he> he who changes the use of a loaned object without the owner’s consent <he>נקרא גו׳</he> is called a robber. Ib. I, 60ᶜ top <cite ref="C00674"><he>גו׳</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>גַּזְלָנִים</he>, <he>גַּזְלָנִין</he>, <cite ref="C00349"><he>גּוֹזְלָ׳</he></cite>. Snh. l. c. Ib. 38ᵃ; a. fr.
